_comment: Merge the `hooks` block into ~/.claude/settings.json. Each entry pipes the hook payload to hooks/post-hook.sh, which POSTs it to the hub daemon and always exits 0 with `{}` on stdout — so Claude Code keeps working when the hub is offline. The optional argument is the curl --max-time in seconds (default 3); PreToolUse uses 40 because permission prompts can block.
_install_comment: Copy hooks/post-hook.sh and hooks/statusline.sh to ~/.claude/hooks/ before merging this block, so the $HOME-based paths below resolve.
_statusline_comment: statusline metrics (context %, cost, tokens, lines changed) are NOT delivered via hooks. Add the following to ~/.claude/settings.json alongside the hooks block, pointing at $HOME/.claude/hooks/statusline.sh (or your own script with the buddy forwarding lines added): "statusLine": { "type": "command", "command": "$HOME/.claude/hooks/statusline.sh", "padding": 0 }
